correctness.rationale: Anchor hub values to 0 and t and project to 1-perp (Jacobian 1/sqrt(m+2)). Hub edge gives |t|≤1 and m conditional leaf intervals of length 2−|t| centered at t/2. Integrating gives volume density (2−|t|)^m, normalized second moment Et²=T_m and conditional independent zero-mean leaf noises of common variance B_m. The Euclidean S_m decomposition of 1-perp into hub difference, leaf contrasts and hub-leaf mode gives precisely the stated eigenvalues. Rational identity for sign of T_m/2−2B_m/(m+2) is −[2^(m+1)(4m−20)+3m²+20m+41]/[6(m+1)(m+3)D_m(m+2)] after positive normalization, zero only at m3 and sign m2 versus m≥4. Exponential scaling m|t|/2→Exp(1) with uniform moments gives T~8/m² and B→1/3, hence condition number and determinant/volume isotropic constant asymptotics. Exact rational independent checks m2..60 of sign identity, threshold and eigenvalues; finite is corroborative.
